data.title: 奥萝拉 · 血月天穹下的血之狂舞
data.description: 夜幕天穹中悬挂着巨大红月，奥萝拉凌空而立，手中凝聚着如血般猩红的魔力长镰，黑发狂舞，神态妖艳凌厉而从容。
data.location: open midnight sky dominated by a massive ominous blood-red moon
data.action: floating gracefully in midair wielding a giant glowing crimson scythe of blood magic, long black hair billowing wildly, fierce regal smirk
data.lighting: 巨大血月浩瀚绯红月华与暗红魔力暴涨光晕
data.mood: calamitous majestic power, intoxicating sinister elegance, overwhelming dominance
data.promptProse: Floating beneath a giant blood moon, witch Aurora brandishes a massive glowing red blood scythe as wind whips her black hair.
data.animaCaption: She floats gracefully against the colossal blood-red moon, her ornate violet scythe gleaming with crimson magical fire.
